From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-18T16:10:00Z
Subject: AWS listing page: copy + entitlement sync for CloudDocs offer

Hi Sara and team,

Thanks again for the time earlier — excited to get the CloudDocs offer ready for AWS Marketplace. Attached is our first-pass product page copy and the draft AMI/SKU mapping (clouddocs_aws_listing_v1.docx, ami_mapping.csv).

Quick asks so we can lock the listing this week:
- Can you confirm the three pricing tiers you want displayed (Starter, Growth, Enterprise) and whether the Starter tier should show a 14-day trial?
- Confirm which AMI IDs we should surface vs internal-only (see column C in ami_mapping.csv).
- Any objections to the benefit statement in the hero: “Secure, low-latency document search with on-prem parity”? We want something concise but defensible for marketplace review.
- AWS PM: can you confirm co-sell badge eligibility and any extra metadata (ISV Accelerator, Sales Connect) we should include?

Target: aim to submit to AWS by EOD Friday (2028-07-21) so we have time for the listing review cycle.

Attachments: clouddocs_aws_listing_v1.docx (proposed product page copy), ami_mapping.csv (SKU/AMI mapping).

Thanks — I’ll consolidate feedback and circulate a final stub for signing.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Partner Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment stubs: clouddocs_aws_listing_v1.docx (edit suggestions welcome), ami_mapping.csv (CSV, 12 rows)

From: Sara Patel <sara@clouddocs.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace PM <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T09:04:00Z
Subject: Re: AWS listing page: copy + entitlement sync for CloudDocs offer

Tessa — thanks, this looks great. Quick clarifications: 
- Pricing: Starter = $0.00 (free trial for 14 days), Growth = $0.10/MAU, Enterprise = contact us for pricing. We also want a monthly and annual toggle if possible.
- AMIs: we’ll expose the public AMI (ami-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8) and keep the accelerated-quantized AMI internal for now. I added notes in the CSV.
- Hero claim: fine but can we soften to “Secure, low-latency document search designed for enterprise workloads”? Avoid saying "on-prem parity" — compliance team flagged the phrase.

We also want to request a Private Offer option for our pilot customers — can you add that to the listing notes?

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

Best,
Sara Patel
Head of Cloud Partnerships
CloudDocs Inc.

Thanks Sara — good catches. I pulled the product page into Word and added inline copy suggestions (clouddocs_aws_listing_v1_kp_comments.docx). Highlights: 
- Hero: updated to "Secure, low-latency document search designed for enterprise workloads" per compliance note.
- Bullets: tightened 3 benefit bullets to be metric-forward (e.g., "Reduce avg. search latency to <200ms for 90% of queries"). Keep one plain-language bullet.
- Trial language: recommend we show the 14-day trial on Starter but add a CTA to contact sales for Enterprise (AWS requires clear trial terms).
- Pricing toggle: note for AWS PM — we should include both monthly and annual price points in the price table; that's supported but it must be in the metering section.

Jonas — added a TODO to confirm co-sell eligibility flags and whether CloudDocs qualifies for the AWS ISV Accelerate program; can you confirm partner-side?

I also added an FAQ snippet about data residency and logging so marketplace reviewers have quick answers.

K

--
Kimberly Park
Marketplace & Field Playback Lead
Redwood Inference
